purpose: Interview walkthrough of agent overload fixes

categories.title: Find and reuse work
categories.caption: Keep discovery relevant as saved tasks grow.

cards.title: Search instead of loading the roster
cards.problem: Every request carried all saved agent names.
cards.change:
Use saved task links, or keyword + semantic search.
Show at most 30 compact candidates, 10 at a time.
cards.benefit:
The model sees relevant work; the full directory
stays in storage.

cards.title: Check identity before continuing
cards.problem: Similar tasks can involve the same person.
cards.change:
Inspect the current saved record and stable task ID.
Reject conflicting confirmed invoice or case IDs.
cards.benefit:
Avoid continuing the wrong task. Example: the same
sender's INV-1042 and INV-1043 are different tasks.

cards.title: Reuse work before creating more
cards.problem:
New agents can duplicate an existing task
and split its history.
cards.change:
Search active and archived work before creation.
Continue a verified match under its existing ID.
cards.benefit:
Keep one task's history together and reduce
duplicate agents.

categories.title: Keep context useful
categories.caption: Small prompts, with original details still available.

cards.title: Bound the conversation context
cards.problem: The shared chat grows with every interaction.
cards.change:
Give the Interaction Agent budgeted conversation
memory and recent saved task links.
cards.benefit:
Keep the chat context manageable while retaining
links for requests such as 'continue that task'.

cards.title: Load a compact task memory
cards.problem:
A long-running task builds up more history
than its worker needs on every run.
cards.change:
Load structured task state, a summary of earlier
work, and recent history within a fixed budget.
cards.benefit:
Keep working context bounded as task history grows.
Token counts are estimates with a safety margin.

cards.title: Retrieve exact details on demand
cards.problem:
A summary may omit an exact amount,
recipient, or instruction.
cards.change:
Preserve new tool results as full source records.
Retrieve original events or large-result excerpts.
cards.benefit:
Check exact details without putting every original
record into the prompt.

categories.title: Run and maintain work
categories.caption: Bound execution and preserve task continuity.

cards.title: Put all executions in one queue
cards.problem:
Unrestricted starts can overload resources
or update the same task at the same time.
cards.change:
Chat and triggers share a persistent queue:
4 running, 100 waiting, at most 1 run per task.
cards.benefit:
Bound active work and prevent concurrent
updates to the same saved task.

cards.title: Limit stalls and recover safely
cards.problem:
Stalled jobs hold resources; a restart or retry
can leave work uncertain.
cards.change:
300-second run deadline; resume unexpired queued
jobs. Allow 1 automatic safe read-only retry per request.
Writes or unknown tools require review if interrupted.
cards.benefit:
Release stuck workers and preserve recovery options
without blindly repeating an uncertain action.

cards.title: Return related results together
cards.problem:
Parallel jobs finish at different times,
creating fragmented follow-up handling.
cards.change:
Save each request's result group. Deliver it after
the group is sealed and every job is terminal,
including failed or rejected jobs.
cards.benefit:
Handle related outcomes together. Defaults also
cap follow-up stages at 5 and submissions at 20.

cards.title: Archive completed work safely
cards.problem:
Completed tasks accumulate, but being inactive
does not mean a task is finished.
cards.change:
Archive explicitly completed tasks after 30 inactive
days. Pending work, approvals and active triggers
prevent automatic archival.
cards.benefit:
Reduce active-list clutter. Archived tasks stay
searchable and can be reopened for continuation.

evidence.limitation: Offline test doubles do not prove live model selection or real Gmail workflow success. Single backend process.

As saved tasks and histories grow, the model sees more irrelevant context and too much work can run at once.
We bound what the model sees, what each worker remembers, and how much work runs.

Recorded offline results · November 14, 2026 · Tests were not rerun for this board

129 automated tests passed.
100% recall@30 across 60 labeled retrieval cases.
No identity-conflict or ambiguity-guard failures.
Candidate pool stayed at 30 with 1,000 and
10,000 saved agents.

Offline embeddings and model/Gmail behavior are test doubles.
Candidate recall does not prove the live model chooses
correctly or that real Gmail tasks succeed.
Live end-to-end testing is still needed.
This implementation supports one backend process.
Numbers are configurable defaults. The sequence diagram explains the message flow; this board explains the decisions.
